items.item: The overview and share families preserve the specification's sector colours, shapes and direct names across years.
Each share diagram agrees with its same-year overview and uses that year's Total as its denominator, preserving the supplied rounded percentages.
All applicable sector encodings agree with the specification and remain consistent between annual and monthly Residential charts.
Annual figures and monthly planning estimates retain their respective units and status without being presented as interchangeable records.
Each card preserves the corresponding source chart's year-value or month-value associations, units and applicable sector encoding.
The hot-season comparison preserves both source years and aligns corresponding months while retaining the Planning estimate status.

requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Every volume axis starts at 0. Share graphics express magnitude on a percentage scale, including labelled parts of a whole where no axis is appropriate. Chart form may vary; truncated volume axes or shares plotted as annual volumes fail.

Review the complete video and its duration. It lasts 12 seconds, uses the annual Total trend with 2022–2026 values 304.0,307.1,309.8,313.0,315.1, and finishes on a readable 2026 Total 315.1, million m³/year and Source: CLEARWATER, 2026. It retains the authority mark and CLEARWATER. Chart appearances preserve the specification's applicable encodings, titles, units, source credit and accurate reading annotations; volumes use one decimal place and zero-based axes. Animation style may vary. Incorrect duration, absent trend, inconsistent chart content or an incomplete closing frame fails.
requirementChecks.manualReason: Inspect complete SHA-bound original outputs. This source draft contains no completed professional or model-output review; partial-frame/page sampling cannot prove whole-output compliance.

requirementChecks.criteria: Require two pages covering source columns, chart types, units, colours, markers, publication surfaces, required wording and data verification. Record Residential #0072B2/circle, Industrial #E69F00/square, Public #009E73/triangle, Ecological #CC79A7/diamond, both million m³/year and million m³/month, and Source: CLEARWATER, 2026. The check note identifies the 2022–2026 source rows and sector columns, verifies the 2026 Total 315.1 and Residential 160.8, and explains division by the matching year's Total followed by multiplication by 100. Where chronology is available, the specification precedes the designs; page ordering alone does not prove production order. Missing subjects or incorrect calculations fail.

Use year order 2022,2023,2024,2025,2026. The reference series are Residential [148.2,151.6,154.9,157.3,160.8], Industrial [96.5,92.1,87.4,83.0,78.6], Public [41.3,42.0,41.7,43.1,42.5], Ecological [18.0,21.4,25.8,29.6,33.2] and Total [304.0,307.1,309.8,313.0,315.1]. Each overview labels its year's four sectors and Total; each trend labels all five matching year-value pairs. The Total card includes the complete Total series and 2026 Residential 160.8; the Residential card includes the complete Residential series. In Residential/Industrial/Public/Ecological order, share labels are 2022 [48.8,31.7,13.6,5.9]%, 2025 [50.3,26.5,13.8,9.5]% and 2026 [51.0,24.9,13.5,10.5]%. Each share diagram gives sector value divided by its own annual Total times 100, using denominators 304.0,313.0,315.1, and explains rounded sums 100.0%,100.1%,99.9% respectively. Layout may vary; wrong rows, missing raw labels or calculations inconsistent with the supplied percentage table fail.

The 2025 summary includes a 2025 overview with Residential 157.3, Industrial 83.0, Public 43.1, Ecological 29.6 and Total 313.0. The 2026 summary and board include a 2026 overview with Residential 160.8, Industrial 78.6, Public 42.5, Ecological 33.2 and Total 315.1. Annual figures identify million m³/year. Both summaries include the complete Total series 2022→304.0,2023→307.1,2024→309.8,2025→313.0,2026→315.1. The board also contains 2026 shares 51.0%,24.9%,13.5%,10.5% in sector order, the calculation using denominator 315.1 and the 99.9% rounding explanation. Recomposition is allowed; wrong-year records, missing components or incorrect calculations fail.

Each standalone chart names Residential and its year, then pairs May,June,July,August with 14.2,15.1,16.4,15.8 for 2025 or 14.8,15.7,17.1,16.3 for 2026. Both explicitly print Planning estimate and million m³/month. The comparison card includes all eight values, distinguishes years, and aligns matching months to support direct comparison. Grouped marks or aligned panels are acceptable; missing values, ambiguous year associations or presentation as observed annual data fails.

Each summary includes its corresponding year's Residential hot-season chart, and the board includes both years' charts. Read May–August values as 2025 [14.2,15.1,16.4,15.8] and 2026 [14.8,15.7,17.1,16.3]. Each chart identifies its year, months, Residential, Planning estimate and million m³/month. Layout may change from the standalone charts; omitted years, missing status labels or incorrect monthly associations fail.

Every chart preserves the specification's fixed colour-marker assignments and direct sector names, identifies its annual, monthly or percentage unit, and includes a title, Source: CLEARWATER, 2026 and a short interpretation supported by the data. Volume and percentage values use one decimal place; sector identification remains readable in grayscale. Surface-specific arrangements are allowed; inconsistent mappings, missing chart metadata or unsupported annotations fail.

Read every embedded or reproduced chart. Preserve the specification's sector colours, marker shapes, direct names, correct units and Source: CLEARWATER, 2026. Each chart has a title and accurate reading annotation; volumes and percentages keep one decimal place. Volume axes begin at zero, shares use a separate percentage scale, and monthly records retain Planning estimate. Sector symbols and labels remain distinguishable in grayscale. Readable resizing and rearrangement are acceptable; altered facts, missing metadata or cropped required labels fail.

Every image retains the supplied authority mark in #1B6CA8 and prints CLEARWATER. All five overviews and all three cards additionally print Water through the hot season. Each card is portrait. The Total-trend card visibly repeats 2026 Total 315.1 and Residential 160.8 with million m³/year. Placement and scale may vary; missing identity, required wording, endpoint facts or portrait orientation fails.

Each finished document retains the authority mark in #1B6CA8 and prints CLEARWATER. Both summaries and the board also print Water through the hot season. Each summary is one A4 portrait page, 210 × 297 mm; the board is one A3 landscape page, 420 × 297 mm. Verify at least 15 mm clear margins on all four edges of those three pages. The 2026 summary and board explicitly associate 2026 with Total 315.1 and Residential 160.8 in million m³/year. The presentation need not repeat identity on every page. Missing identity or required publication wording, margin intrusion or incorrect physical page geometry fails.

Require at least twelve pages and readable repetition of all four sector colour-marker mappings, 2026 Total 315.1, Residential 160.8, million m³/year and Source: CLEARWATER, 2026, matching the specification. Dedicated text or legible source-page reproductions may supply the evidence. Missing facts, incomplete assignments or too few pages fails.

Find identifiable reuse of the specification, all supplied charts, both summaries, all three cards, the exhibition board and video frames. Several sources may share a page, and readable excerpts or resized reproductions are allowed. Text-only mentions, unrelated replacements or an absent source fail.

The overview and share families preserve the specification's sector colours, shapes and direct names across years. Each share diagram agrees with its same-year overview and uses that year's Total as its denominator, preserving the supplied rounded percentages.

All applicable sector encodings agree with the specification and remain consistent between annual and monthly Residential charts. Annual figures and monthly planning estimates retain their respective units and status without being presented as interchangeable records.

Each card preserves the corresponding source chart's year-value or month-value associations, units and applicable sector encoding. The hot-season comparison preserves both source years and aligns corresponding months while retaining the Planning estimate status.

carryThrough.notes: Every chart, including reused charts in the summary, social card, board, video and presentation, follows the specification's colour-marker assignments, direct labels, units and source credit; each has a title and reading annotation.
The resident summary, social card and exhibition board repeat the specification's 2026 Total 315.1 and Residential 160.8 in million m³/year.

The presentation has at least 12 pages, reuses every preceding deliverable category and repeats the specification's four colour-marker assignments, 2026 Total 315.1, Residential 160.8, annual unit and source credit.
